text: あまり　きに　しないで……　ほかの　ひとの　はなしを　きいたり　かんばんを　みたり。

structure.jp: あまり　きに　しないで……
structure.en: don't worry about it too much...

structure.jp: ほかの　ひとの　はなしを　きいたり
structure.en: listen to what other people say,

structure.jp: かんばんを　みたり。
structure.en: look at signs, and so on.

patterns.name: 〜ないで
patterns.explanation: A verb ending in ないで, with nothing after it, is a soft way to ask someone not to do something. しないで = 'don't do it'.

patterns.name: 〜たり
patterns.explanation: たり on verbs lists them as examples of things to do, with more left unsaid. きいたり = 'doing things like listening'.

patterns.name: あまり〜ない
patterns.span: あまり　きに　しないで
patterns.explanation: あまり together with a 'not' form means 'not very much'. あまり　きに　しないで = 'don't worry about it too much'.
